newsitem.title: USA: Pacificare sees slower rev growth.
newsitem.headline: Pacificare sees slower rev growth.

text.p: PacifiCare Health Systems Inc said that although commercial pricing trends continue to show signs of improvement, it expects to see a slowing in revenue growth.

The company said it will continue to exercise a disciplined product pricing strategy which, combined with a greater emphasis on profitable member retention, will undoubtedly lessen its top line growth rate.
It said it continues to experience high prescription drug expenses due to enhanced Medicare drug benefits and higher cost trends.
It also said considering divestiture of some newly acquired markets.
